name: Qualifier Agent — Binary Score + Instant Handoff

UP_signals: Has budget signal in custom fields

steps.label: Qualifier Entry — Binary Ask
steps.message:
{{contact.first_name}}, quick qualifier before I connect you with the team. 3 fast ones:

1. Are you the decision maker? YES/NO
2. Are you looking to start in the next 30 days? YES/NO
3. Is [BUDGET QUALIFIER e.g. $500/mo] within range? YES/NO

Text 3 YESes and I route you straight to the closer. 🎯

steps.label: Qualifier Email — Deeper Intel
steps.subject: One minute — tell me where you stand
steps.body:
{{contact.first_name}},

Before we spend each other's time, I want to make sure this is the right fit.

Answer these 3 questions and I'll know instantly:

1. What's your biggest bottleneck right now with [AREA]?
2. Have you tried solving it before? What happened?
3. If we could fix it in 30 days, what would that be worth to you?

Hit reply — I read every one.

{{location.name}}

steps.label: Score Trigger — UP Path
steps.message: ✅ {{contact.first_name}} — you're qualified. I'm connecting you with [CLOSER NAME] right now. They'll send a calendar link in the next 2 minutes. Watch for it.

steps.label: Score Trigger — DOWN Path
steps.message: {{contact.first_name}}, based on your answers, we're not the right fit right now — and I'd rather tell you straight than waste your time. I'll keep your info and reach out when the timing makes more sense. 🙏
